title: CodeSprint 5.0
description: CodeSprint is the institute's flagship competitive programming contest, now in its fifth edition. Participants will tackle algorithmic problems across three difficulty tiers — Beginner, Intermediate, and Expert — over a gruelling 3-hour window. Topics include dynamic programming, graph algorithms, segment trees, and number theory. Individual participation only. Online judge platform will be used. Cash prizes worth ₹25,000 to be won. Past editions have seen participation from 15+ colleges across Uttar Pradesh.
prerequisites: Proficiency in at least one programming language (C++, Java, or Python). Familiarity with basic data structures.

title: Git, GitHub & DevOps Fundamentals Workshop
description: A hands-on, beginner-friendly workshop designed to equip students with practical skills in version control and modern software development workflows. Topics covered include Git branching strategies, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Docker basics, and deployment to cloud platforms. Students will work through a real mini-project during the session. Bring your own laptop with Git pre-installed. Limited seats to ensure personalised attention.

speakers.name: Mr. Kunal Sharma
speakers.designation: DevOps Engineer, Infosys Ltd.

speakers.name: Ms. Priyanka Nair
speakers.designation: Software Development Engineer, Zoho Corporation

prerequisites: Basic knowledge of any programming language. Laptop with Git installed is mandatory.

title: Rang Tarang – Spring Cultural Fest
description: Rang Tarang is the institute's beloved annual Spring Cultural Festival, a two-day extravaganza celebrating art, music, dance, drama, and creative expression. Events include Battle of Bands, Nukkad Natak (street theatre), Western and Classical Dance Competitions, Standup Comedy Night, Photography Exhibition, and the much-awaited Mr. & Ms. Rang Tarang contest. Open to students from all colleges in the region. Food stalls, artisan market, and live performances by invited artists will run across both days.
prerequisites: None. Open to all.

title: Research Methodology & Academic Writing Seminar
description: A two-session seminar aimed at preparing undergraduate students for research internships, postgraduate admissions, and technical paper writing. Session 1 covers research problem formulation, literature review techniques, and citation tools (Zotero, Mendeley). Session 2 focuses on academic writing conventions, IEEE/Springer paper formatting, and navigating journals and conferences. Special focus on how to convert final-year projects into publishable papers. Certificate of participation will be issued.

speakers.name: Dr. Priya Menon
speakers.designation: Associate Professor, IIT Roorkee (Dept. of Computer Science)

speakers.name: Prof. Anirban Ghosh
speakers.designation: Technical Editor, Springer India

prerequisites: None. Open to all UG and PG students.

title: Khelotasav – Inter-Department Sports Meet 2026
description: Khelotasav is the annual inter-departmental sports championship bringing together all six engineering branches and the postgraduate departments in healthy competition. Sports include Cricket (box format), Football, Volleyball, Badminton (singles and doubles), Table Tennis, Chess, and 100m/400m Track Events. Events are spread over four days. Points are tallied to determine the overall Sports Champions Trophy for 2026. All registered students are eligible to participate.
prerequisites: Must be a currently enrolled student. Registration through team captain.

title: HackVerse 4.0 – 24-Hour National Hackathon
description: HackVerse 4.0 is the institute's premier national-level hackathon, open to teams of 3–5 members from colleges across India. This edition's themes are AI for Social Good, Smart Cities, FinTech Innovation, and Healthcare Technology. Teams will build working prototypes over 24 continuous hours and present to a jury of industry professionals and venture capitalists. Total prize pool: ₹1,00,000. Top teams get direct interviews with participating companies. Mentorship sessions, tech talks, and sponsor stalls will run throughout.

speakers.name: Ms. Divya Goyal
speakers.designation: Product Manager, Microsoft India

speakers.name: Mr. Siddharth Rao
speakers.designation: Co-Founder & CTO, AgriTech Startup – CropSense

speakers.name: Dr. Nandita Krishnan
speakers.designation: AI Research Scientist, Google DeepMind India

prerequisites: Team of 3–5 members. At least one member must have software development experience. Bring own laptops.

title: CyberShield – Cybersecurity Awareness & CTF Challenge
description: CyberShield is a two-part event combining a morning awareness seminar with an afternoon Capture the Flag (CTF) competition. The seminar covers social engineering attacks, phishing case studies, network security fundamentals, and best practices for digital safety in college and corporate environments. The CTF is a team-based competition (2 members per team) with challenges in web exploitation, cryptography, reverse engineering, and OSINT. Beginners are welcome for the seminar; CTF is recommended for CS/IT students with some networking knowledge.
venue: Computer Centre CC-03 & Seminar Hall SH-02

speakers.name: Mr. Rohit Malhotra
speakers.designation: Ethical Hacker & Certified CEH, Wipro Cybersecurity

speakers.name: Ms. Tanvi Agarwal
speakers.designation: Information Security Analyst, CERT-In (Govt. of India)

prerequisites: Seminar: None. CTF: Basic understanding of networking and Linux commands recommended.

title: Deep Learning & Neural Networks Workshop
description: A comprehensive two-day workshop that takes participants from the mathematical foundations of neural networks to building and deploying real models. Day 1 covers perceptrons, backpropagation, activation functions, CNNs, and RNNs using PyTorch. Day 2 dives into Transfer Learning, Transformer architectures, fine-tuning pre-trained models (BERT, ResNet), and deploying models with FastAPI. Participants will train a complete image classification model and an NLP sentiment analysis pipeline. All code and datasets provided. GPU cloud credits sponsored by the institute.

speakers.name: Dr. Arun Joshi
speakers.designation: Research Scientist, Samsung R&D Institute India – Bangalore

speakers.name: Ms. Kavya Reddy
speakers.designation: ML Engineer, Flipkart AI/ML Team

prerequisites: Python programming (intermediate level). Basic knowledge of linear algebra and probability. Familiarity with NumPy and Pandas is advantageous.

title: Guest Lecture: Generative AI in Industry – Opportunities & Risks
description: An industry-focused guest lecture examining how Generative AI (LLMs, diffusion models, multimodal systems) is reshaping software development, content creation, healthcare, and enterprise workflows. The speaker will discuss real deployment challenges including hallucination, bias, data privacy, and responsible AI governance. A Q&A session will follow the main talk. Particularly relevant for CSE, ECE, and Data Science students considering AI-focused careers or higher education. The lecture will be recorded and made available to registered attendees.

speakers.name: Mr. Arjun Mehta
speakers.designation: Principal Applied Scientist, Adobe Systems India

prerequisites: None. Open to all students and faculty.

title: RoboWars – Robotics & Automation Challenge
description: RoboWars is a multi-category robotics competition open to teams from all engineering branches. Categories this year include: Line Follower Robot (autonomous), Manual Bot Racing, Robo Soccer (3v3 bots), and Drone Obstacle Navigation. Teams must bring their own hardware. A preliminary technical inspection of bots will be held the evening before the event. The competition emphasises embedded systems, sensor integration, and real-time control. Prize money: ₹40,000 across all categories. Registration limited to one team per category per college.
venue: Electronics Lab Block & Open Ground OG-01

speakers.name: Prof. Vaibhav Kulkarni
speakers.designation: Professor, Dept. of Electronics, IIT Kanpur

prerequisites: Team of 2–4 members. Must bring own hardware. Prior robotics/embedded systems experience strongly recommended.

title: Data Science & Analytics Bootcamp
description: A three-day intensive bootcamp covering the complete data science workflow — from raw data to actionable insights. Day 1: Data collection, cleaning, and exploratory data analysis (EDA) with Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn. Day 2: Supervised and unsupervised machine learning using Scikit-learn (regression, classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction). Day 3: Real-world case study — building an end-to-end predictive analytics dashboard with Streamlit. Each participant will receive a project certificate on successful completion of the case study. Hosted in collaboration with Analytics Vidhya.

speakers.name: Mr. Harsh Vardhan Tiwari
speakers.designation: Senior Data Scientist, Mu Sigma Inc.

speakers.name: Ms. Sneha Kulkarni
speakers.designation: Analytics Lead, KPMG India

speakers.name: Dr. Ramesh Babu Nair
speakers.designation: Assistant Professor, IIT Delhi (Dept. of Mathematics)

prerequisites: Python programming (basic to intermediate). Knowledge of basic statistics. Laptop with Anaconda/Jupyter installed.

title: Ideathon 2026 – Campus Startup Challenge
description: Ideathon 2026 invites student teams to pitch innovative startup ideas solving real-world problems in areas such as EdTech, AgriTech, HealthTech, Clean Energy, and Rural Infrastructure. Teams of 2–4 present a 5-minute pitch followed by a 3-minute Q&A before a jury of angel investors, startup founders, and industry mentors. Shortlisted teams from Ideathon will receive incubation support from the institute's Startup Incubation Centre (SIC), mentorship credits, and seed funding of up to ₹50,000. Previous editions have produced two successfully funded startups.

speakers.name: Mr. Vivek Bindra

title: Cloud Computing & AWS Essentials Workshop
description: A practical one-day workshop introducing students to cloud computing concepts and Amazon Web Services (AWS). Topics include cloud deployment models, EC2 and S3 fundamentals, serverless computing with AWS Lambda, database services (RDS, DynamoDB), and basic IAM security. Participants will deploy a full-stack web application to AWS during the session. AWS Educate accounts will be provisioned for all participants with ₹500 cloud credits. Taught by a certified AWS Solutions Architect.

speakers.name: Mr. Amitabh Sinha
speakers.designation: AWS Certified Solutions Architect & Cloud Consultant, TCS

prerequisites: Basic understanding of web development (HTML/JS/Backend). Laptop required. AWS Educate account creation instructions will be sent after registration.

title: TechFusion 2026 – Post Mid-Sem National Technical Symposium
description: TechFusion 2026 is the institute's flagship three-day national technical symposium, held immediately after the mid-semester examination period. This edition brings together students, researchers, and industry professionals across five technical tracks: Artificial Intelligence & ML, Embedded Systems & IoT, Cloud & Distributed Computing, Cybersecurity, and Sustainable Engineering. Events include paper presentations, technical quiz, project expo, industry panel discussions, hands-on workshops, and an evening networking mixer. Over 40 colleges participated in the previous edition. Best paper presenters receive conference registration support for IEEE-sponsored events.
venue: Main Auditorium, Seminar Halls & Lab Blocks

speakers.name: Dr. Manish Kumar Gupta

title: Full-Stack Web Development Bootcamp
description: A four-day intensive bootcamp covering modern full-stack web development using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js). Participants will build a complete social media micro-application from scratch, covering REST API design, JWT authentication, responsive UI design with Tailwind CSS, state management with Redux, and deployment on Vercel and Render. Focus is on production-ready coding practices. Students completing all sessions will receive a verified digital certificate. A project-based assessment is included on Day 4.

speakers.name: Mr. Yash Thakur
speakers.designation: Senior Frontend Engineer, Razorpay

speakers.name: Ms. Richa Bansal
speakers.designation: Backend Developer & Tech Lead, Paytm

prerequisites: Basic HTML/CSS and JavaScript knowledge required. Laptop with Node.js (v20+) installed. VS Code recommended.

title: DataQuest – Inter-College Data Science Competition
description: DataQuest is a Kaggle-style inter-college data science competition hosted on the institute's proprietary platform. Teams of 2–3 will receive a real-world dataset (domain revealed on event day) and must produce the highest-accuracy predictive model within 6 hours, with evaluation based on both model performance and a 10-minute final presentation on methodology and insights. Past datasets have included crop yield prediction, hospital readmission risk, and urban traffic forecasting. Prizes: ₹20,000 (1st), ₹10,000 (2nd), ₹5,000 (3rd). Sponsored by Persistent Systems.

speakers.name: Dr. Sunita Verma
speakers.designation: Head – Data Science, Persistent Systems Ltd.

prerequisites: Team of 2–3 members. Strong Python skills required. Familiarity with Scikit-learn, Pandas, and model evaluation metrics.

title: AI Research Conclave 2026
description: A full-day research-focused conclave bringing together faculty, PhD scholars, and undergraduate researchers to discuss cutting-edge developments in Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and Reinforcement Learning. The programme includes invited keynote talks, a poster presentation session for student research projects, and a panel discussion on 'AI in Bharat – Research Priorities for the Next Decade'. Undergraduate students with ongoing research projects or internship research outcomes are especially encouraged to submit poster abstracts. Selected papers will be recommended for publication in the institute's technical journal.
organiser_club: Research & Innovation Cell & Dept. of Computer Science Engineering

speakers.designation: Associate Professor, IIT Guwahati – AI & Data Science

prerequisites: Open to all students and faculty. Poster presenters must submit a 300-word abstract by 10th July 2026.

title: IoT & Embedded Systems Workshop – From Arduino to Industry
description: A two-day hands-on workshop bridging the gap between hobbyist tinkering and industrial IoT deployments. Day 1 covers Arduino and Raspberry Pi basics, sensor integration (temperature, ultrasonic, IR, gas), and MQTT protocol for device communication. Day 2 advances to ESP32 programming, LoRa communication, interfacing with AWS IoT Core, and building a real-time environmental monitoring dashboard. Participants build and keep a basic IoT sensor kit assembled during the workshop. Hardware kits included in the fee.

speakers.name: Mr. Deepak Ahuja
speakers.designation: IoT Solutions Architect, Bosch India Engineering Centre

speakers.name: Ms. Meghna Pillai
speakers.designation: Embedded Systems Engineer, Texas Instruments India

prerequisites: Basic electronics knowledge (resistors, circuits, sensors). Laptop required. No prior microcontroller experience necessary.

title: Monsoon Mela – Mid-Year Cultural Evening
description: Monsoon Mela is a relaxed, student-organised cultural evening to celebrate the midpoint of the semester after the intensity of mid-semester examinations. Events include an Open Mic Night (poetry, comedy, spoken word), an Acoustic Music Jam, an Art & Photography Exhibition by students, a board game tournament, and a collaborative mural-painting session. Food stalls from local vendors will be set up across the courtyard. No formal competitions — pure celebration of creativity and community.
prerequisites: None. Open to all students and faculty.

title: InnoSprint – 12-Hour Product Ideation Sprint
description: InnoSprint is a fast-paced 12-hour product ideation and prototyping sprint challenging teams to design a digital product (web, mobile, or AI-powered) that addresses a specific problem statement revealed at event start. Unlike traditional hackathons, InnoSprint emphasises UX design thinking, user research, and product strategy over raw coding. Teams must deliver a clickable Figma prototype and a business canvas by hour 12. Judged by product managers and UX designers from leading tech companies. Winning team gets paid internship interviews at three sponsor companies.

speakers.name: Mr. Rahul Garg
speakers.designation: Senior Product Manager, Swiggy

speakers.name: Ms. Nandini Sharma
speakers.designation: Lead UX Designer, Phonepe

prerequisites: Team of 3–4 members. Basic familiarity with Figma or any wireframing tool is helpful but not mandatory.

title: Monsoon Cup – Annual Football & Cricket Tournament
description: The Monsoon Cup is a week-long outdoor sports tournament played across two formats: a 7-a-side football league and a T10 cricket tournament. Teams are formed by branch-wise registration and compete in a round-robin group stage followed by knockout rounds. The tournament is a much-awaited post-mid-sem tradition and draws enthusiastic crowds from across the campus. Matches are played in the evening to avoid the afternoon heat. Referee-controlled fixtures, point tables, and live scorecards will be updated on the student portal.
prerequisites: Must be a currently enrolled student. Team registration via branch sports representative.

title: Resume & LinkedIn Masterclass – Campus to Career
description: A practical half-day masterclass designed to help penultimate and final-year students build compelling resumes and LinkedIn profiles tailored for top tech company placements and campus recruitment. Covers ATS optimisation, STAR-format project descriptions, how to quantify achievements, LinkedIn SEO strategies, and building a public portfolio. Includes one-on-one live critique sessions where a recruiter reviews real student resumes on the spot. All registered participants receive a 30-day access code to a premium resume builder tool. Seats strictly limited.

speakers.name: Ms. Ankita Mishra
speakers.designation: Campus Recruiter, Accenture India

speakers.name: Mr. Gaurav Tiwari
speakers.designation: Senior HR Business Partner, Infosys – Hiring Division

prerequisites: Preferably 3rd and 4th year students. Bring a printed copy of your current resume for the live critique session.

title: MLOps & AI Deployment Summit
description: A full-day summit bridging the gap between machine learning research and production deployment. Sessions cover the complete MLOps lifecycle: experiment tracking with MLflow, model versioning, CI/CD for ML pipelines, containerisation with Docker, model serving with FastAPI and TorchServe, monitoring model drift, and responsible AI in production. The afternoon includes a 3-hour hands-on lab where participants instrument a full ML pipeline on a cloud sandbox environment. Targeted at students who already know ML and want to learn how real-world AI products are built and maintained.
venue: Computer Centre CC-01 & CC-02 & Innovation Lab
organiser_club: AI & Machine Learning Club & Cloud & Infrastructure Club

speakers.designation: AI Infrastructure Engineer, NVIDIA India

prerequisites: Working knowledge of Python and at least one ML framework (Scikit-learn or PyTorch). Familiarity with REST APIs. Laptop required.
